# uxp-lint/no-unsupported-html

Disallow HTML elements, attributes and patterns that UXP documents as unsupported (HTML via @html-eslint/parser, and JSX).

**Type:** problem · **Recommended:** warn · **Strict:** error

## What it checks

Works on HTML parsed by `@html-eslint/parser` and on JSX. Reports elements Adobe lists as unsupported (`ul`, `ol`, `li`, `i`, `em`, `strong`, `q`, `blockquote`, `pre`, `code`, `title`) unless they are styled (a class/style attribute, or a type selector in the project's CSS: Adobe's documented workaround, detected by `uxpConfig()` as `settings.uxp.styledElements`); unsupported global attributes (`hidden`, `contenteditable`, `dir`, `spellcheck`, …; `aria-*` only with `aria: true`; custom elements such as `sp-*` are skipped); `<input type=file|color>`; `<label for>`/`htmlFor`; forms that are not `method="dialog"`; `<textarea rows/cols>`; `<option>` without `value` or with `disabled`; `<select value>`; inline `on*` handlers in HTML; JSX `defaultValue`; and React `onChange` on `sp-*` (React before 19 does not forward it to web components; detected from package.json as `settings.uxp.reactVersion`). Options: `elements`, `attributes`, `aria`, `inlineHandlers`, `ignore` (message ids or names).

## Examples

### Incorrect

<sub>manifest: `host PS 24.0.0`</sub>

```html
<label for="name">Name</label><input id="name">
```

<sub>manifest: `host PS 24.0.0`</sub>

```html
<select><option>One</option></select>
```

### Correct

<sub>manifest: `host PS 24.0.0`</sub>

```html
<label>Name <input id="name"></label>
```

<sub>manifest: `host PS 24.0.0`</sub>

```html
<select><option value="one">One</option></select>
```

## Options

| Option | Type |
|---|---|
| `elements` | boolean |
| `attributes` | boolean |
| `aria` | boolean |
| `inlineHandlers` | boolean |
| `ignore` | string[] |

## Messages

- `element`: {{message}}
- `attribute`: Global attribute `{{name}}` is not supported by UXP.
- `inputType`: {{message}}
- `labelFor`: `<label {{attr}}>` is not supported in UXP; wrap the control inside the <label> instead.
- `formMethod`: UXP forms only support `method="dialog"`; they do not submit to a URL.
- `textareaSize`: `<textarea {{attr}}>` is ignored in UXP; size it with CSS width/height.
- `optionValue`: `<option>` needs a `value` attribute in UXP, otherwise `select.value` returns undefined.
- `optionDisabled`: `<option disabled>` is not supported in UXP.
- `selectValue`: `<select value=...>` does not select the option in UXP; set `selected` on the <option> or call setAttribute("value", ...).
- `inlineHandler`: Inline `{{name}}` handlers are not reliable in UXP; attach listeners with addEventListener.
- `defaultValue`: UXP input elements do not accept `defaultValue`; set `value` instead.
- `spEvent`: React (before 19) does not forward `{{name}}` to the `<{{el}}>` web component, so the handler never runs. Attach a `change` listener with a ref and addEventListener, or upgrade to React 19.

## When not to use it

For HTML that only runs inside a WebView.
